description: Aparcamiento para motos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Villanueva de la Serena. Information about motorcycle parking in the municipality of Villanueva de la Serena. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Villanueva de la Serena. The portal shows the English title as "Motorcycle parking" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Villanueva de la Serena. Its keywords include vva_transporte_aparcamiento_motos_105, Aparcamiento para motos, Unidades Administrativas, IDEVVA, features, Transporte. The listing shows 2021-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendata.villanuevadelaserena.es/terminos). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
